compare_meshes_chamfer: compute chamfer distance and evaluation metrics between predicted and ground truth 3D meshes
compare_meshes_precision_recall: compute precision, recall, and F1 scores at various distance thresholds for mesh comparison
compare_meshes_normal_consistency: compute normal consistency and absolute normal consistency between predicted and ground truth meshes
scale_meshes_for_comparison: scale predicted and ground truth meshes using a uniform scalar or bounding box normalization
sample_meshes_surface_points: sample uniform points and normals from mesh surfaces or use vertex positions as samples
